title: Messaging — Subscribe to Traffic Monitor — payload

filter.description: Selects the traffic events the subscription receives. Absent or empty selects every traffic event the requester is entitled to see.

leaseSeconds.description: How long the subscription lives unless renewed. Default 300.

maxEventsPerSecond.description: Rate ceiling the subscriber can absorb; the mediator MAY apply a lower one. Events over the ceiling are counted as dropped, never queued.

subscriptionId.description: Renew or re-filter an existing subscription held by the same requester. Omitted = create a new one.

traffic.description: False turns traffic events off, so that the subscription receives only the membership events it opts in to; `filter` MUST then be absent. Absent or true keeps them on, as in 0.1.

membership.description: Opts the subscription in to mux membership events and selects which. Absent: no membership events — they are never sent by default.

Response.title: Messaging — Subscribe to Traffic Monitor — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a messaging/monitor/subscribe request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/messaging/monitor/subscribe/0.2#response.

filter.description: The filter in force, after the mediator narrowed it to what the requester is entitled to see.

traffic.description: Present and false exactly when the subscription receives no traffic events.

membership.description: The membership filter in force, after the mediator narrowed it to what the requester is entitled to see. Absent when the subscription receives no membership events — because none were asked for, or because the mediator does not offer them (mux not enabled, or a mediator implementing only 0.1).
